svg.title: Pitcrew features
svg.desc: See what needs you: Crash loops, stalls and paused runners stand out on one dashboard. Updates that wait their turn: Checked on two hosts, applied when idle, rolled back if needed. Insights from your own jobs: Success rate and queue time per repository, with capacity advice. Clean up with a preview: See what would be freed before anything is deleted.
svg.text: Everything a self-hosted runner needs to stay up.
